facts.text: Evan experienced a health scare last week that involved a suspicious finding during a check-up, which caused him to feel frightened.

evidence.quote: Last week, I had a health scare and had to go to the hospital. They found something suspicious during a check-up, which freaked me out.

facts.text: Evan was reassured by medical professionals that everything is fine following his health scare, and he is currently doing well.

evidence.quote: Doctors said everything is fine, but it taught me the value of life.

facts.text: Sam has been experiencing discomfort that limits his movement and has been attempting to make dietary changes to address it.

evidence.quote: As for me, I've been dealing with some discomfort and it's been limiting my movement. I've been trying to make changes diet-wise, but it can be hard.

facts.text: Sam mentioned that he has not tried many new hobbies recently but received a 'feel good' movie yesterday, which he has been watching as a way to cope.

evidence.quote: I haven't tried much new lately, but I did get this yesterday. It's been my go-to 'feel good' flick.
